protocol.format: Native B1 greedy, GPU-only, INT8 KV, FP32 GDN state, cold requests
protocol.timing_cohort: six existing TranscriptPrompts, 256 output tokens each
protocol.order: uninterrupted A1 B1 B2 A2; up to five groups, stop at three stable
protocol.exclude: endpoint spread >5% in either arm; retained, never exclude for speedup or fidelity
protocol.primary_metric: sum request wall seconds / sum output tokens; includes prefill and first token
protocol.secondary_metrics: speculative cycle wall/GPU time, TTFT, preparation, warmup, process wall, peak RSS
protocol.floor: max(2%, 2 * largest endpoint spread among stable groups)
protocol.inference: fixed-cohort descriptive bootstrap over groups; not general workload inference
protocol.fidelity: complete input and output arrays compared in each group; long probes unreplicated
protocol.calibration: first input of existing native-quality64 cohort, no expected answers; fixed rows1..8, 96 output tokens; median actual matching-row cycle wall costs
protocol.long: frozen source-reading runtime-8192/runtime-16384 inputs, 64 output tokens; fidelity and pilot only
